# AOMIL

> AOMIL supplies Christmas and Halloween decorations for wholesale, OEM and private-label seasonal collections.

Official website: https://aomil.com/
Contact: info@aomil.com; WhatsApp +86 18617029976.
English, Spanish and French pages are available on the official website. Confirm specifications, music functions, availability, MOQ and customization directly with AOMIL for each model.

## Christmas product categories
- [Christmas snow globes and lanterns](https://aomil.com/snow-globe.html)

- [Christmas tree toppers](https://aomil.com/tree-topper.html)
- [Christmas projector lights](https://aomil.com/projector.html)
